title: Third-order mixed electroweak-QCD corrections to Delta r
family_label_in_paper: generic three-loop self-energy integral, eqs.(8)-(9) (D1..D9 with arbitrary masses m1..m9)
description: 3-loop 2-point ladder (LA) topology: closed fermion loop (top on one side of a W rung, massless b on the other) with a gluon rung; O(N_f alpha^2 alpha_s). Two scales (mt, MW) plus p^2.
mapping_notes: CONSTRUCTED, not a family named in the paper: the paper only defines the generic 9-line parametrisation (used for vacuum d/dp^2 at p^2=0 and on-shell self-energies) without mass assignments. A brute-force graph search shows the only 8-line graph in this parametrisation (dropping any one line) is the planar 3-loop ladder (triangle-box-triangle). JSON line order: q1, q1+p, q2, q2+p, q2-q1, q3-q1, q3, q3+p (8 physical) + q3-q2 (aux ISP). Masses: lines q2,q2+p = top (mt^2=9/2), q2-q1 = W (MW^2=1), others massless (b quarks + gluon q3-q1). JSON order vs paper labels: [D1,D2,D4,D5,D3,D6,D7,D8 | D9 aux]. Paper masses: m4=m5=mt (top), m3=MW, m1=m2=m6=m7=m8=0 (b quarks, gluon on D6), D9 ISP.
reference_notes: Paper prints no master-integral values (MIs computed with AMFlow/TVID2, only final Delta r numbers given).
confidence: low: family is my reconstruction of a representative hardest O(N_f alpha^2 alpha_s) self-energy topology; paper gives no explicit sector/mass assignment.
